All requirements in BRIEF.md (R-01, R-02, R-03) are now implemented and committed separately:

- **R-02** (`ea08ea6`): `list` command — prints `- <text>` per note or `no notes` when empty
- **R-03** (`eddfd31`): `list --json` — prints the notes as an exact JSON array

Both were added via TDD (failing tests confirmed before implementation). Full suite: 11/11 tests passing, working tree clean. No new scope showed up beyond what BRIEF.md already specified, so nothing needed re-approval.
